profile.name: Prosegur Cash, S.A.
profile.summary: Prosegur Cash, S.A. provides integrated cash cycle management solutions and automating payments in retail establishments and ATM management in Europe, LATAM, and internationally. The company offers local and international transport services through land, sea, and air, such as collection, transport, custody, delivery, and deposit in vaults for funds and other valuable goods. It also provides cash management and handling, and automation services consisting of counting, processing, reconditioning, securing storage, packaging, delivering, and recycling banknotes and coins, as well as cash flow monitoring and tracking systems and ATM replacement services; Cash Today, which automates payments in retail establishments; ATM management solutions comprising planning, loading, monitoring, first- and second-tier maintenance, and balancing services; value offshore systems services; correspondent banking services, such as management of collections and payments and invoice collection services, currency exchange services; and digital asset custody service. In addition, the company offers added-value offshore system services; cash back services for purchases at the supermarket, online travel bookings, reservations, and gift card purchases; and digital wallets. It serves financial institutions, retail establishments, government agencies and central banks, and mints and jewellery stores. The company was incorporated in 2016 and is headquartered in Madrid, Spain. Prosegur Cash, S.A. is a subsidiary of Prosegur Compañía de Seguridad, S.A.
profile.summary_fr: Prosegur Cash, S.A. fournit des solutions intégrées de gestion du cycle de trésorerie et d'automatisation des paiements dans les établissements de détail et la gestion des guichets automatiques en Europe, LATAM et à l'international. La société offre des services de transport locaux et internationaux par voie terrestre, maritime et aérienne, tels que la collecte, le transport, la garde, la livraison et le dépôt dans des coffres-forts pour les fonds et autres biens de valeur. Il fournit également des services de gestion et de traitement de la trésorerie et d'automatisation comprenant le comptage, le traitement, le reconditionnement, la sécurisation du stockage, l'emballage, la livraison et le recyclage des billets et des pièces, ainsi que des systèmes de surveillance et de suivi des flux de trésorerie et des services de remplacement de guichet automatique; Cash Today, qui automatise les paiements dans les établissements de détail; solutions de gestion de guichet automatique comprenant la planification, le chargement, la surveillance, la maintenance et la maintenance.
